notes: Independent harsh C5 round-4 review. Verdict is FAIL for six disconnected street-facing principal buildings, not for the repaired southern L contacts or current source drawings. All coordinates are native final-image coordinates; rectangles are [x,y,width,height] and use compose.py physical ground_footprints, not sprite tops. All six have zero positive-length contact with another principal building; checks against declared architectural-prop footprints also find no connection. The west-smith/cobbler contact with court-closure is point-only. The previous critic-r17C5-3 southern failures are resolved: south-L-1/south-L-2 share the 48 px segment at x336,y1248–1296, and south-L-return/south-L-3 share 48 px at x576,y1200–1248. The old south-corner-workshop is incorporated into south-L-2. The current shared_ground_edges correctly rejects point contacts. This review extends that same criterion to the whole district. Scope and viewing: read BRIEF-17 in full, both panel briefs, NOTES method sections and all 20 FIXES items. Inspected all 120 C5 manifest exports at literal 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x on 45 critic asset plates; examined the complete 1920x1440 city at 1x and as sixteen exact 4x tiles, the named crops, native comparison references and greyscale. Inspected roof joins at 8x, complete roof/reference proofs, both tall/low orientations, the L/T proof and curtain/stair/tower proof. Literal 3x3 repeats cover the active paving, workyard, cobbles, roads, lane, ditch and roof fills; directional roads/ditches and roof fills are judged on their intended joining axes as well as the full repeat. Props were composited over summer grass and workyard ground. No seasonal exports belong to C5, so summer/winter partner overlays are not applicable; all 42 slate/brown palette partners have byte-identical alpha masks to their source. Independent technical checks: all 120 exports match manifest sizes/hashes, use alpha 0/255, have zero RGB under transparency, and have no detached 1–2-pixel alpha components. All 24 applicable facade panels preserve course rows 0 and 47. Replayed all 72 recorded registered-image reductions (38,668,288 source samples) using exact 8x8 RGBA mode with deterministic tie-breaking; every mode image and source hash matches. Fresh in-memory compose output equals the saved native final; 2x and three 3x crops are exact nearest-neighbour derivatives, squint equals native greyscale, and comparison panels are pixel-identical to their native sources. Repetition: current final 167 audited five-piece windows, L/T acceptance 20, retained E L-block 22, market 47 and height-test 20 all have zero failures. Reintroducing the old north-rear cap and all-eight-identical trade-shop defects makes the auditor reject them. These are saved-art and composition checks, not runtime collision/pathfinding tests. Storeys: 40 modular principals, histogram {1:3,2:14,3:11,4:8,5:4}, 7.5% one-storey. Including seven one-storey ancillary ranges/market hall and the two-storey court closure gives 48 buildings, histogram {1:10,2:15,3:11,4:8,5:4}, 20.8333% one-storey, below 25%. Church/guildhall and defensive towers are separate landmarks. Roof mix is 20 terracotta, 13 slate, 7 brown among modular principals: terracotta is exactly 50%. FIXES coverage: the current art visibly addresses pitched roof volumes/joins/returns and materials (1–4), irregular occupied civic square and church access (7–8), differentiated ground/contact shade (9–10), defensive joins and operation (11,19), integrated trades/goods/entrances (12–14), building/roof variety and repetition (15), purposeful market activity (16), low working/poor forms and forge (17), and secondary destinations (18). Property attachment and inhabited continuous edges remain incomplete in the locations above (5–6 and coordinator/standing frontage rules); consequently full-city acceptance in 20 remains incomplete despite the repaired focused proofs. No frontage lawn was observed. The street plan does have bends, T-junctions, stepped blocks, mixed heights, a gate-road inn and uneven towers; this is not merely a colour-change submission. BRIEF-17 takes precedence over panel suggestions to shrink signs, deepen principal lots or waive the eight-cell street-change rule. The coordinator 40x30-cell directive correctly takes precedence over the approximate 1200x900 showcase suggestion. No extra source-art failure is assigned to an intact drawing merely because an instance is misplaced. Only critic-r17C5-4.json and critic-r17C5-4-*.png review artifacts were written; no production artwork, compositor, notes, branches, commits or pushes were changed.
